digest.component_or_area: LLM step failure observability across review gates
propositions: LLM step failure tally from review-plan must be extended to review-code and verify-completion gates via activating collect_step_failures() sink scope and draining into coverage.llm_step_failures on each verdict
review-code gate already has coverage object; wiring requires activating sink at gate_dispatch.py:480 and draining beside contract-violation drain in code_review/workflow_ops.py
verify-completion verdict must create coverage object only when tally is non-empty (no empty container on clean signed runs) by draining in completion_reconcile before validate_structured
code_review_verdict and completion_verdict schemas must declare coverage.llm_step_failures with required [total, by_step] structure mirroring plan_review_verdict
Clean runs must have coverage key absent entirely (no empty container), preserving byte-identity and attestation safety on signed verdicts
